title: ML Fundamentals Starter
description: Build core ML intuition from scratch: supervised vs unsupervised learning, the bias-variance tradeoff, how to split data correctly for evaluation, recognizing overfitting and underfitting, why feature scaling matters, and how gradient descent optimizes a loss function.
outcomes: You'll distinguish supervised, unsupervised, and semi-supervised learning, explain the bias-variance tradeoff and where models fail, correctly structure a train/validation/test split, recognize overfitting and underfitting from training curves, identify which algorithms require feature scaling, and describe how gradient descent minimizes a loss function.
